senses.gloss: m. (הבי, הוי, cmp. הבל) [breath,] vanity, vain talk; impossibility, exaggeration, rhetorical phrase.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:1">Ned. III, 1</cite> <he>נדרי הב׳</he> vows made dependent on an impossibility, expl.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 3:2">ib. 2</cite> <he>קונם וכ׳</he> I may be forbidden …, if I have not seen &c. (a mere exaggeration not meant literally).
<cite ref="Nedarim 24b:5">Ib. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>שבועות ה׳</he> oaths affirming &c. (<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 3:8">Shebu. III, 8</cite> <he>שבועת שוא</he>).

<cite ref="Chullin 90b:13">Ḥull. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>לשון הב׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>הו׳</he>) exaggeration in rhetorical speech; <cite ref="Tamid 29a:21">Tam. 29ᵃ</cite>; a. e. V. <cite ref="C00350"><he>גּוּזְמָא</he></cite>.
